text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Katsuragi Ace's debut race just around the corner,
one day—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Alright, that's the last one!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Heheh. Thanks to Trainer, the quality of my solo training's gone way up...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Before, my only option for training methods was asking the instructors, so they only taught me the basics...—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Meanwhile, those who were part of clubs or had relatives with racing connections were doing specialized training tailored to them.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't have anything like that.
So I had no choice but to desperately grind out
the basic training I was taught... But—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (Now I have my Trainer! A reassuring presence who devises the training I need in a way that suits me best!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch...!
I'm gonna get super strong from here on out...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
—Ooh, Es-cchi!
Workin' hard on your solo training, I see~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Ace-chan, good work out there.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's going on here?
Are you two doing voluntary training too?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(—These two are my buddies who've been close with me
ever since I came to the academy.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(And starting this year, we'll be in the same racing class.
Which means we're rivals now, too.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's encouragement, encouragement!
Es-cchi, you were just about to take a break, right?
Wanna chat for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Ace-chan, I heard your debut race
is coming up soon... so I wanted to talk.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
—Still, we're really lucky,
aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hm? Lucky?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Look. All of us got Trainers
and were able to make our debuts, right?
I was just thinking... how amazing that is.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Totally!
And the fact that we're in the same class
is like, an absolute miracle~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"...I was so anxious the whole time.
...Thinking that maybe, I'd never get to debut."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone in the club cheered me on,
and I enrolled with high expectations. The one thing
I refused to accept... was graduating without ever running...—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
I totally get it~. Having come this far,
there's no way I'd wanna settle for half-measures either~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Right? That's why I was so happy
when you scouted me! Knowing that I could finally
run in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: I felt like... my dream had finally come true—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, hold on! Isn't it the other way around?
It hasn't come true yet—you're gonna make it come true now!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah yeah! It's only gonna get way more hype from here!
For now, let's go crush your debut race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Well, having C.B.-san as a contemporary is tough luck, to say the least. Guess you just gotta pray you don't cross paths in a race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, you're right.
Yeah. First... I've gotta run!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was rare to see Katsuragi Ace showing
any sign of gloom during training,
so I couldn't help but ask her about it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it's nothing.
Just got lost in thought for a sec, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“......Sorry.
Truth is, there actually was a little.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh.
In that case, I'll let my dependable Trainer listen to all of it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Katsuragi Ace told me all about
her conversation with her two friends from earlier—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer,
did you catch on after hearing that just now?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
My pals. Neither of them ever once...
said they had feelings like 'I wanna win.'

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Back when the two of them first became buddies,
things were a lot different than they are now—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, at the send-off party, I made a declaration.
That I'd become an amazing Umamusume who wins graded races
and challenges the Classic Triple Crown...!”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm the opposite~! Everyone sent me off saying,
"You'd better become a GⅠ Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh~, must be nice for both of you!
As for me, people just said, "Don't push yourself,"
and nobody really expected anything from me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Well, Ace-chan is a bit unique, or rather,
how should I put it...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Still, that's just how it is.
If you've come to Tracen Academy,
you've gotta climb your way up and make a name for yourself!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"Tha-at's right!
Let's all keep winning and aim for the top!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
I want to put up a record that everyone
in the club can be proud of, too...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—"I want to win. I want to become a strong Umamusume."
Back then, the two of them spoke those feelings
so naturally. They were able to say it with ease.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: However... as I spent more time at the academy—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ――Yaaahhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Whew! Another totally awesome day of weather!
My speed's gonna keep getting super pumped up♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Maruzen-senpai...!
She's already utterly overwhelming just in training...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You know, Maruzen-senpai comes from
a really great family, right?
It's like... she just feels like one of the chosen ones.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: ...So that's the academy's top class...—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Haha!
...She's on a whole 'nother level—

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey... are those two seriously pre-debut?
That tandem workout just now... was totally insane...”

text_block_list.name: Spectator Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously. It's the Symboli and Mejiro families, you know?
Their environments were already different before they even enrolled.
...That's what true "elites" are, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: ...A genuine, true elite...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: …………Senpai, so you're really leaving, huh...

text_block_list.name: Ace's Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
It's just that... it doesn't look like I'll be able to debut anymore.

text_block_list.name: Ace's Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Well! For an Umamusume raised in a regular household, that's about par for the course! Honestly, I feel lucky just being enrolled here!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I've secured a job offer too!
Man, I'm so glad I studied hard!

text_block_list.name: Ace's Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hang in there, Ace!
You've got real guts!
A Trainer will definitely pick you up!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, yes.

text_block_list.name: Ace's Senior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Well then... I'll be off.
I can't wait to see you make your debut
and shine out there, Ace!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—And just like that,
we were forced to confront so many harsh realities.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And... I've seen just as many, if not more,
setbacks and farewells—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "...You understand, don't you, Trainer? At Tracen Academy, that kind of harsh reality and setback isn't rare at all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As a Trainer, I understand. Tracen Academy's gates are extremely narrow, and even though talented Umamusume gather from all across the nation—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In the midst of all this, those who can truly
shine in the racing world are but a tiny handful."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And to become one of that chosen few,
it is an unavoidable truth that where you are born
and the environment you grow up in are crucial factors."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...'Retiring without ever winning a single race.'
In the racing world, that's actually
closer to common sense—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, there are plenty who leave the academy
without even getting the chance to debut.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy—and the world of racing—undeniably
carries within it many such "harsh realities," making it
a truly unforgiving place—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, that doesn't mean
I'm going to stop running...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I've seen plenty of harsh realities at this academy.
I've tasted firsthand the vast divide
between different backgrounds and upbringings.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's precisely why I want to keep moving
forward without stopping—
I want to fight without accepting it...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I... want to win.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I want to run through my debut race
and prove that I'm an Umamusume who can win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I believe I understand what it is
that Katsuragi Ace wants to shatter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like her, even knowing the reality of it,
I have no intention whatsoever of meekly accepting it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've long been prepared to face any hardship
together with Katsuragi Ace...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Heheh—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Thanks for listening! I feel a whole lot better now!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...All right! I gotta become a winning horse girl
and prove to my pals that 'we can do this too!'

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
First, the debut race—
I'll run it with everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sharing the determination to fight against "reality",
they moved forward toward the debut race once more—
